intent: Develop a multiplayer-style turn-based chess game in the browser with move validation, undo, timers and a polished UI.

spec.goal: Build a browser-based, multiplayer-style turn-based chess game with move validation, undo, timers and a polished UI.
spec.deliverable: A working browser chess game (web app) that lets players take turns, with legal-move validation, an undo function, game timers and a polished interface.
constraints: Must run in a web browser.
Play is turn-based with a multiplayer-style experience between players.
Moves must be validated against the rules of chess.
Must include an undo feature for moves.
Must include timers for the game.
The UI must look polished and professional.
done_criteria: The game runs in a browser and shows a playable chessboard where players alternate turns.
Illegal moves are rejected and legal moves are accepted according to chess rules.
A player can undo a move and the board returns to the previous position.
Timers are visible and count down during each player's turn.
The interface is visually polished and consistent.
spec.summary: You want a browser-based turn-based chess game for multiple players, with move validation, undo, timers and a polished look.
